summary: The PR proves the InclusiveStructureFunctions Layer 0.2 bullet 'the antisymmetric, conserved, covariant part is a single multiple of the parity-odd form' as one unit, with the Basic/Kinematics additions all consumed by the new file; no parity-odd satellites exist on main. Its switch from IsLorentzCovariant to proper covariance is justified in-PR by eq_zero_of_isLorentzCovariant but contradicts the roadmap text and must be fed back to the roadmap repo.
